next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.21.3 SR2 lets USAGE be written on a group and on its subordinates. §2023:13.18.60.3 SR2, applied to report entries by §2023:13.15.4 GR2, permits the same 'but the same usage shall be specified in both entries'. That added condition refuses no 1985 program: 1985 report USAGE can only be DISPLAY (§1985:XIII.3.21.2 '[ USAGE IS ] DISPLAY'), so group and subordinate usages never differ, and §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR2 already required 'the same usage must be specified in both entries'.
